Name: Running Late
Author: Jishuna
Description:
Allows for the customization of the digital clock on the HUD, including changing it to update every in-game minute instead of every 10.
Settings can be edited in-game via GenericModConfigMenu.

[size=5][u]Install[/u][/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/65111556?tab=user+files]My other mods[/url]
